description: Optionally inspect tools by ID when selection or valid request construction depends on missing/stale contract details. Provider comparison: Inspect each candidate to confirm current scope/contracts; Probe each when current quotes are required. Returns parameters, success rate, latency, examples, and billing_rule when available. Use tool_ids from a previous discover call.

search_id.description: The search_id from the discover response that returned the tool(s). Optional but recommended for linking to the original discovery.

session_id.description: Session identifier for tracking user sessions. If not provided, an auto-generated session ID will be used.

tool_ids.description: Array of tool IDs to retrieve information for. These IDs should come from previous discover results.

name: inspect
